Chapter 6946: Kill Him

Chapter 6946: Kill Him

Breaker’s green gaze changed from life to death, proportional to his murderous intent.

Other immortals shuddered upon seeing this.

“Want to destroy my world?” Li Qiye smiled since his world was at no risk of being destroyed.

Breaker’s brutality was meaningless since he couldn’t reach the nine worlds at all. Of course, he would have to get through Guardian Alliance as well - an impossible task.

“Sir, it appears you won’t yield today.” Breaker said.

“No reason to do so.” Li Qiye said.

“My branch has no feud with Guardian Alliance...” He continued.

“I move independent of Guardian Alliance. I’m the one who wishes to destroy your branch, no need to bother them.” Li Qiye said.

Everyone found this surprising because they thought Li Qiye was a representative of Guardian Alliance. This didn’t seem to be the case.

“Okay, it’s getting late. Since you are smart, I’ll let you pick your death. I can’t say the same for your son.” Li Qiye declared nonchalantly.

“Is he really this strong?” The immortals wondered.

They didn’t doubt his ability to destroy the branch, but to take down a primordial immortal effortlessly?

If Breaker could be killed so easily, someone else would have done it long ago to rid Heavenrealm of a troublemaker. Only a celestial immortal could do so and Li Qiye didn’t look the part.

Breaker gathered enough energy in his eyes to cause ripples all around Heavenrealm. Other immortals of his branch didn’t believe this mortal could kill all of them either.

“Bam!” Breaker grasped a weapon out of the void. The world had a hard time bearing its weight. Fabrics of reality turned into fog upon contact.

This was a stone hammer. The long wooden handle was old and withered, attached to a square block of stone. Cracks covered the hammer head; the radiance of death oozed outward.

He didn’t need to swing. Just toss this hammer into a world would reap all lives in the blink of an eye.

“Sovereign of Death.” A primordial immortal among the crowd became startled.

“A legacy artifact.” Another took a deep breath.

This was a prerequisite for becoming a primordial immortal. It didn’t need to be a weapon. All that mattered was that it needed to be one with its owner.

Most forged them into weapons, nurtured by primordial essence and blood. Thus, to a great extent, it was a part of their lives, allowing them to unleash their true power.

Although not all legacies existed during the primordial era, they must still be made from some primordial parts. Therefore, they were suitable as weapons.

Unfortunately, primordial materials were awfully rare in the present Heavenrealm. The ones with true legacies from the start of time were called primordials. Unfortunately, this race was gone now. The cultivation state, primordial, was named after them.

“We will not go down without a fight.” Breaker pointed his hammer at Li Qiye.

Having said that, he tossed the hammer to his son and ordered: “Kill him, this will be a great contribution.”

Treasure accepted the hammer and froze for a moment. Just a while ago, his father had abandoned him to appease Li Qiye. The guy was even willing to kill him personally.

Now, he was given a primordial artifact. Once he regained his wits, he ecstatically shouted: “I will kill him for you, Father.”

The remaining six immortals of the branch also stepped forward to join him.
